title: QPS Signature Recorder and Customer Throughput Proof Bundle
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description: Build a compact recorder that samples tenant request traffic and emits a replayable QPS signature profile plus a runnable benchmark driver and a customer-facing proof bundle. The goal is to provide reproducible evidence of Dedicated pool throughput guarantees under steady-state and microburst scenarios, including autoscaling behavior and orchestration traces.
acceptance_criteria: Recorder harvests a one-hour sample and serializes a compact profile under 1MB
Replay driver reproduces target average QPS within plus/minus 7 percent over a 10 minute steady window
Tail latency metrics (p99, p999) captured and correlate with SLA assertions or documented deviation rationale
Autoscaler scale-up and scale-down events are observable in controller logs and annotated in the run report (scale-up observed within 60s for burst policy)
Customer bundle includes step-by-step runbook, expected metric thresholds, troubleshooting guide, and links to artifacts (GitHub PR, Confluence playbook, telemetry dashboards)
